MRI has been validated in vivo, showing very high correlations in muscle cross-sectional area measures of the arms and legs when compared to cadavers (7, 22, 62). However, as with CT, accuracy can be somewhat compromised when subjectively interpreting boundaries between muscles in close proximity to one another, especially muscles with multiple heads (22).
